reviews.review_description:
Room Bricker XR is a brilliant take on the classic brick breaker formula. Watching neon bricks appear across your real walls instantly makes the gameplay feel fresh and immersive.

The room adaptation works surprisingly well, the gameplay is responsive, and the huge amount of content keeps introducing new ideas. With 100 levels, upgrades and power-ups, there's always something new to discover.

An excellent showcase of how Mixed Reality can reinvent a timeless arcade genre. A jewel!
